note: KDWP state fishing lake 4 miles south and 1 east of Independence, in old coal strip-mine country along Coal Creek, with oak-hickory bluffs over the water. Several angler campsites off the gravel access roads; three boat ramps and the two vault toilets are on the north shore. No hunting, no alcohol, no off-road vehicles or horses. --Claude
summary: KDWP Montgomery page (Wayback 2026-04-22, the latest): several angler campsites off gravel access roads, no hookups, showers or drinking water, two vault toilets; free/FCFS; max 7 nights, showers/potable_water false and vault_toilets added; all groups re-sourced. Pin on a small gravel loop by the west arm, inside KDWP land; not waterfront kept. Phone missing -> (620) 331-6820.
flags: PHONE missing (apply.py doesn't write it): propose (620) 331-6820 (area phone on the KDWP page; Google the same).

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept: the pin is in a wooded patch beside a small gravel turnaround loop on the north side of the lake's west arm, ~25-40 m from the water through trees. The angler campsites are not mapped on the page; the open gravel lots by the north-shore ramps (10-20 m from the water) are boat-ramp parking, not designated sites on anything I read.
DRIVE-IN: the page names 'gravel access roads' and the pinned loop is on one; the angler sites are reached by car. Strip-mine bluffs are on the south side; tracks there were not checked site by site.
PIN 37.16578,-95.69936 is ~15 m from that gravel loop, inside the KDWP polygon. Not moved (no camping area is mapped; Google's point 37.16454,-95.69708 is on the lake).
WEBSITE stored ksoutdoors.gov area page confirmed (live 403; latest Wayback 2026-04-22). Google's link is an old ksoutdoors.com URL.
LAKE ACREAGE: not stated on the KDWP page.
FIT: gravel loops off gravel roads; a 23-ft motorhome fits the pinned loop. No caveat.
